name: Team CBLT
source:
Team CBLT is an entirely free to play visual novel and fan-game based on the anime-esque web series RWBY, created by the Austin-based company Rooster Teeth Productions.

CBLT is a game that follows the adventures of an original character team. This is the titular Team CBLT, comprised of Cobalt Blue, Blaze Achen, Lilac Silver, and Teal Brimstone. You start their adventures as they first arrive at Beacon Academy, a school where they'll spend the next four years learning how to become Huntsmen and Huntresses, the protectors of their world responsible for defending the people against soulless monsters known as the creatures of Grimm.

As you go through the game, you'll be able to make friendships, bonds and even romances with other characters, both original to the game and from the show RWBY. Some of these bonds will influence your storyline ending, and possibly even have an effect on canon events from the show.
translation:
《Team CBLT》是一部完全免费的同人视觉小说，改编自奥斯汀公司Rooster Teeth Productions制作的日式风格网络动画《RWBY》。

本作讲述一支原创角色小队的冒险故事，也就是标题中的CBLT小队，成员包括科尔巴特·布鲁、布雷兹·阿肯、莱拉克·西尔弗和蒂尔·布里姆斯通。他们初到信标学院时，冒险也随之开始。在接下来的四年里，他们将在这里学习成为猎人，肩负守护世界的职责，保护人们免受名为“戮兽”的无魂怪物侵害。

随着游戏推进，你可以与其他角色建立友谊、结下羁绊，甚至发展恋情，其中既有游戏原创角色，也有《RWBY》中的角色。一些羁绊会影响你的故事结局，甚至可能改变动画原作中的事件。
